title: Crockpot Sausage and Peppers Pasta
description: A hearty and flavorful crockpot sausage and peppers pasta dish.

ingredients.item: crushed red pepper flakes (optional, for spiciness)

steps: Place the sausage in the crockpot.
Add the sliced onion, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, and orange bell pepper.
Add the minced garlic, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and crushed red pepper flakes if using.
Pour in the marinara sauce and stir well.
Cover and cook on high for about 3 hours.
After cooking, remove the sausages and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Return the sausage pieces to the crockpot and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pasta and stir until well coated.
